observations: body L1-L5: Schiaparelli's addition begun on p. 236 goes on here; the dash before his name in L5 measures 9.7 pt, and a heavy bracket closes the addition.
body L2, L4, L14, L20: the dashes of «ar–Raqqah» and «al–Battānī» are long dashes (5.3 to 5.6 pt).
body L4: the dash that opens the line measures 10.8 pt, with a small tail at its right end, and is transcribed as a dash.
body L7-L8, L12, L15: in the head the dash after «a)» measures 10.2 pt; the dashes after «planetarum.», «repraesentari.» and «deri.» measure 9.6 to 10.4 pt.
body L8: a heavy bracket opens Schiaparelli's addition on the figure of p. 64, which goes on to p. 238.

body L1, L13-L15, L21, L23, L31, L35: specks above «fuit», after «nodos», between «excentrici» and «determinante», above «Rectae», above «Platonis», before «qui» and over «ut» (L23), before «ut» (L31) and after «E′» (L35) are not transcribed.

body L19-L34: Schiaparelli's restoration of the figure of p. 64 stands on the right of these lines and is redrawn from the print: the deflectent GBFD about the Earth E and the eccentric GHKL about M, touching at G; the epicycles about H and L; the line from A, in two dashes to G, through G, E′, M, E, K and C to F; MHQ, EHP, ETN and the radius HT; MLR, ELV, EXZ and the radius LX. The point E′ is marked only by its letter, on the line GF with ME′ = ME (19.9 pt in the print).

body L19-L34: the circle ABCD in dashes is centred 8.9 pt to the left of and 9.3 pt above E, so that it crosses GBFD at the nodes B and D; each dash is drawn where it printed, the short ones and those that touch other strokes included. Where the letters R and V stand on the circle no dash is printed. A short horizontal stroke (3.3 pt) inside the eccentric, level with E′ and 35 pt to its left, belongs to no line of the figure and is not drawn.
body L27, L32-L33: the m of «punctum» (L27), the r of «astr.» (L32) and the t of «t.» (L33) print broken.
body L32: the sign of equality between ME′ and ME is 9.2 pt long.
notes_left L1: the t of «ut» prints without its bar.
notes_left L2: the addenda (Part I, p. LXXIV) read al-mu‘addil for al-mumaththil, the word divided here after «al-mu-».
notes_right L2: the note ends with a comma after the closing quotation mark; the t of «motum» prints without its bar and the q of «quans» is broken.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
